# Jensina Group

> Jensina Group is a construction and expedition (heavy-equipment / building-material hauling) business group in Karanganyar, Central Java, Indonesia, operating through two legal entities: CV Anugerah Jensina Sejahtera and PT Maju Jensina Jaya.

Jensina Group provides building construction services and transporter/expedition services — hauling building materials and heavy equipment for construction projects. The company is based in Ngledok, RT. 003 RW. 008, Kel. Sroyo, Kec. Jaten, Kab. Karanganyar, Jawa Tengah, Indonesia. Content is available in Indonesian (default, no url prefix) and English (`/en/`).

## Company

- Legal entities: CV Anugerah Jensina Sejahtera (construction / "AJS"), PT Maju Jensina Jaya (general contracting & expedition)
- Phone/WhatsApp: 081111130357
- Email: info@jensina.id
- Website: https://jensina.id
